caption: The drawing features a single, prominently displayed brass candlestick, which is primarily rendered in shades of gold and yellow with darker brown shading to indicate its metallic surface and three-dimensional form. The candlestick has a wide, hexagonal base, tapering and then swelling upward through several bulbous and angular sections before ending in a flared candle holder at the top. To the left of the central image, there are two technical line drawings: one is a profile elevation of the candlestick, and below it, another is a top-down hexagonal view of the base. A scale marked in inches from 0 to 3 runs underneath the technical drawings. All these elements are arranged on a lightly yellowed or off-white rectangular background with a drawn border. The name "Philip Johnson" is printed in small capital letters in the bottom left corner.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
